- [ ] Ran `go test ./...`
- [ ] Ran `go build ./...`
- [ ] Ran `go test -race ./internal/tui` if TUI code changed
- [ ] Ran `goreleaser check` if release config changed
- [ ] Updated docs if behavior changed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private URLs, or sensitive paths committed
- [ ] No public release, tag, or package publishing created
